scorecard.rationale: The seed and mustard tea report tracked self-rated motor symptoms without counting falls. The compound trial list gives broad motor scales, with no posted results and no dedicated falls endpoint in the active trial. An observational cruciferous-vegetable result groups several foods. No comparison estimates fall frequency after steamed broccoli in Parkinson disease. An exercise and aging review lists broccoli among sources of quercetin. Its review comparisons do not estimate fall frequency after eating steamed broccoli and support no sign.
